test_strength_note.issue: The above-floor fereg witness compares f64 slices with PartialEq, which treats positive and negative zero as equal; the asserted contract is bit identity.
test_strength_note.recommendation: Compare to_bits() values, as the new CMG witnesses already do. This is a test-strength correction, not an observed output regression.

source_assessment: Team::single_lane preserves the borrowed pool, fixed thresholds and memory policy while lowering the lane ceiling to one. The fixed reduction tree itself is unchanged.
Serial and across-RHS owned/caller-buffer solves propagate the one-lane team into reduction, centering and preconditioning; fereg retains cancellation and its existing workspace/mode selection.
Norm scale maximum retains worker-dependent scheduling, but its finite maximum is order-independent; dot/square sums and single-component centering choose arithmetic by fixed lengths/thresholds.

Previously fused multi-component centering/dot and paired norms can become separate passes when a serial solve now carries a team. Existing equivalence witnesses and source order support equal arithmetic below the reduction floor; this is a performance consideration, not a discovered numeric defect.
M3c bounded emission/memory fixes and allocation-origin cleanup fixture are unchanged by this diff.
witness_assessment: CMG low-threshold fixtures exercise serial/planned/across-RHS owned results and all three caller-buffer contexts at 1/2/4/8 workers, with full solution-bit and diagnostics comparison; component/reduction tests also cover 3 workers and one-lane cancellation.
One fereg OLS projection exceeds the real 131072-entry floor and covers one/three columns at W1/W4 with independent CG comparison and full-FE certification.

The 1e-6 residual agreement is relative to an independently accumulated small residual, not a changed production convergence tolerance. The independent edge accumulation changes summation order and can magnify cancellation error; diagnostic residual/tolerance and backward-error certificates remain separately checked. It is a fixture-specific agreement bound, not a general floating-point error theorem.
coverage_limits: Actual-plugin replay is below the changed arithmetic threshold. It establishes unaffected exactness and existing feature/transaction behavior, not changed-path native OLS/PPML/bias behavior.

Above-floor PPML, both bias modes, warm-start/retained-preconditioner integration and explicit cmgschur coarse centering lack an equivalent new full-native witness; the supplied lower-level CMG evidence and one OLS projection are the changed-path coverage.

Row-operator worker dependence remains bit-neutral in the inspected witness; making CSR storage independent of worker count would change resource policy. Optional Auto RHS batching is omitted and should remain an explicit scope decision.
No tests, builds, native calls, timings or profiles were executed by this review. Host validation and timing remain root-owned; prior milestone exceptions do not accept M3d.
